title: Wire the Engine
prompt: JSON snapshot round-trip with case-insensitive load, plus the DI-wired async service with cancellation.

tests.name: snapshot round-trips exactly
tests.hint: Serialize camelCase + string enums; parse case-insensitively.

tests.name: load tolerates its own output shape and case
tests.hint: Your loader must read what your writer wrote, whatever the casing.

tests.name: BuildEngine hands the store to the service
tests.hint: The composition root's job: one graph, collaborators injected.

tests.name: ids continue across the store, cancellation is honored
tests.hint: Check the token before the store sees anything.

tests.name: invalid input never reaches the store
store failures propagate to the caller
tests.hint: Observe the store task; failures must surface, not vanish.
